cause: Live Cloudflare rewrites public email anchors to a broken protection endpoint; confirmed before fix with a read-only live request.
fixes: Cloudflare email_off opt-out comments surround rendered body content; existing mailto links are preserved without inserting client-side decode dependencies.
Permanent 308 redirects to canonical homepage for 57 historical country slugs and 57 code aliases including nested city paths, plus retired blog, careers, auth and feed URLs.
Origin-side permanent homepage redirect for the reported email-protection endpoint.
Current public pages, private routes, APIs and genuinely unknown URLs retain their intended behavior.

verification.emailBoundaries: Every rendered public mailto anchor is inside the Cloudflare opt-out boundary; no broken email-protection anchor appears in origin HTML.
verification.securityChecks: passed; no catch-all homepage redirect for private files or arbitrary paths

releaseNote: Changes require deployment and Cloudflare HTML cache invalidation. Cloudflare owns /cdn-cgi routes and may answer them before the origin; if the reported URL still returns 404 after deployment, an edge rule or Cloudflare configuration change is required. Origin redirect tests do not prove the live Cloudflare endpoint is fixed.
